title: Monster Speed V3 Step 3 — WNBA cache completeness repair
root_cause: The Step-2 WNBA seed cache used the same key as the targeted WNBA lane but installed only sports_api/requirements.txt plus pytest. It did not install root requirements.txt, so the shared key could restore an incomplete virtualenv without pandas.
patch: Make the WNBA seed install root requirements exactly like the consumer lane and bump only the WNBA cache identity with rootdeps-v2 so the incomplete cache cannot be restored again.
